Name: NIGHT_BOSS_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: The Nightlords in the Expedition menu (names, icons, unlock and defeat flags, sort order) and the weights used to pick the target boss at each Deep of Night depth.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 1 row.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: The expedition name for this night boss.

Fields.Name: Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: The icon to display for this night boss in the Expedition menu.

Fields.Name: Unlock Flag
Fields.Description: The event flag sthat unlocks this night boss as an expedition.

Fields.Name: Defeat Flag
Fields.Description: The event flag set upon defeating this night boss.

Fields.Name: Unknown ID
Fields.Description: Its use is not established. Retail 100100, 100200 ... 100800 on the eight base Nightlords (by boss), -1 on the others.

Fields.Name: Boss Name ID
Fields.Description: The boss name for this night boss.

Fields.Name: Defeated Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: The icon to display for this night boss in the Expedition menu when defeated.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: The ordering in the Expedition Menu.

Fields.Name: Boss Description ID
Fields.Description: The boss description for this night boss.

Fields.Name: Background ID
Fields.Description: The background to display for this night boss in the Expedition menu.

Fields.Name: Effective Affinity 1
Fields.Description: Icon to display in Effective section

Fields.Name: Effective Affinity 2
Fields.Description: Icon to display in Effective section

Fields.Name: Depth 1 Roll Weight
Fields.Description: The weighting to apply during the boss roll.

Fields.Name: Depth 2 Roll Weight
Fields.Description: The weighting to apply during the boss roll.

Fields.Name: Depth 3 Roll Weight
Fields.Description: The weighting to apply during the boss roll.

Fields.Name: Depth 4 Roll Weight
Fields.Description: The weighting to apply during the boss roll.

Fields.Name: Depth 5 Roll Weight
Fields.Description: The weighting to apply during the boss roll.

Fields.Name: Large Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: The icon to display for this night boss in the Expedition menu.

Fields.Name: Force Target Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: When the target boss is picked for a Deep of Night depth: if this event flag is on and the boss's weight for that depth is at least 1, this boss is picked outright. 0 or -1: never. Retail 0.
